Compare Numbers.description: The trigger filters for scores greater than or equal to 0.5. This comparison determines if the score is less than 0.7.

Get Identity.description: This action returns information about the detected outlier identity and their attributes.

Get Identity 1.description: This action returns the detected outlier identity's manager's name and their attributes.

attributes.body:
Hello ${var1},

This email is to inform that your direct report ${var2} has been identified as an outlier with a score of ${var3}. Please consider doing a full access review to determine if ${var2} has excessive access for their job and role.

Thank you,
Corporate Compliance Officer
attributes.subject: Outlier Detected

Send Email 1.description: This action sends an email notification to the outlier identity's manager informing them that the identity is an outlier. This email includes their score.

success 1.description: Because the outlier score was not at or above 0.5 and less than 0.7, no further action is needed.

object.description: This workflow is triggered when an outlier score of higher than 0.5 but lower than 0.7 is detected. An email notification is sent to their manager to inform them the identity is an outlier.
object.name: Send an Email Notification for Detected Outlier Identity (0.5-0.7)

self.name: Send an Email Notification for Detected Outlier Identity (0.5-0.7)
